title: Twitch and Amazon hit with lawsuit for training AI with streamers' content - Engadget
summary: The class action suit claims that Amazon never obtained consent from Twitch streamers to be used to train its AI models. A streamer has taken a stand against Twitch and Amazon using his content to train AI models.
